card.name: Partway through names and long words
card.fires_on: Responds partway through a proper name, foreign-script word, or long term, just before the rest of it is spelled out. Examples are T-usc-any, CLIN-IC-ALLY, Interleuk-in and Abd-al.

modes.label: Split proper names
modes.description: The break falls inside a place or personal name, or an acronym, where more letters must follow.
modes.example: In 1559 the grand duke of T<<usc>>any, Cosimo I de’ Med

modes.label: Split medical terms
modes.description: The break falls inside a long medical word, often in capitals or before a hyphen.
modes.example: WAY MANAGEMENT, AS CLIN<<IC>>ALLY INDICATED. Clostrid

card.plain: It fires in the middle of a longer name or term, when the word is not finished yet.
